Careers at AtomsAI

Building the next global AI company from India

Come solve hard problems in speech, real-time infrastructure, and the products thousands of businesses open every morning. Work that reaches real people on real phone lines, at a scale few teams see.

See open roles 8 open roles
Why the work is interesting

The scale is real. So are the problems

More than a billion conversations a year run through what we build. Every one crosses a live phone network, reaches a person who won’t wait, and matters to a business counting on the outcome.

If that sounds like the interesting part, read on.

Conversations since you opened this page 0 About 32 every second, a billion a year
Four teams

What you’d be working on

Each one is a team, a set of open roles, and a problem that gets harder as the scale grows.

01 · Speech & conversational AI

Make AI better at conversation

Build speech models and conversational intelligence that handle accents, interruptions, and phone-quality audio. Your training data is a billion real calls a year.

  • Speech recognition
  • Text-to-speech
  • Real-time agents
See roles
02 · Infrastructure

Make it work at scale

Run the real-time infrastructure under every call. Milliseconds matter when a person is waiting on the line.

  • Telephony
  • Streaming media
  • Reliability
See roles
03 · Applications

Make it useful to people

Turn the models into products people open every morning. Thousands of businesses already do.

  • JustCall
  • ServiceAgent
  • Product design
See roles
04 · Go-to-market

Take it to the world

Take what we build to the businesses that need it. Customers in 20+ countries, and far more who haven’t heard of us yet.

  • Sales
  • Customer success
  • Developer relations
See roles
How we work

Your work should go further than your desk

Six things we hold to. They're how we decide what to build and who to build it with.

  1. 01

    Own meaningful problems

    You get a problem, not a ticket, and the room to solve it.

  2. 02

    Work across disciplines

    Researchers, engineers, and designers sit on the same problem, not in separate queues.

  3. 03

    Ship, then learn

    Production is the test. What you learn there decides what you build next.

  4. 04

    Think independently

    A good argument beats seniority. Bring one.

  5. 05

    Move with purpose

    We pick the few things that matter and move quickly on them.

  6. 06

    Care about the outcome

    The job is done when the customer's problem is, not when the task closes.

How we hire

Five steps, no surprises

Every step is a real conversation about the work. You'll always know where you are and what comes next.

  1. Step 1

    Apply

    Send what you've built or shipped. A person reads every application.

    Reply within a week
  2. Step 2

    Intro call

    What you're looking for, what the team needs, and whether it's worth both our time.

    ~30 min
  3. Step 3

    Craft conversation

    A deep dive on your work with the people you'd work with.

    ~60 min
  4. Step 4

    Work session

    A real problem from the team, solved together. Take-home work is paid.

    ~90 min
  5. Step 5

    Team and offer

    Meet the wider team, ask anything, and get a decision quickly.

    ~45 min

Durations are placeholders until the hiring team confirms them.

Open roles

Where you could start

Grouped by team, so you can see which problem you'd be working on. We hire in Bengaluru, our headquarters, and remotely across India and the US.

8 open roles
